newsitem.title: ESTONIA: FAKTO ISSUE OVERSUBSCRIBED THREE TIMES.
newsitem.headline: FAKTO ISSUE OVERSUBSCRIBED THREE TIMES.

text.p: Estonia's Nissan dealer Fakto's share issue was oversubsribed three times according to final data, Balti Cresco said on Monday.
The preliminary data, announced last week, showed a double oversubscription, Indrek Rahumaa, the head of corporate finance, told Reuters.
Fakto issued 444,588 shares and the price of a 10 kroon share was 28 kroons. The issue increased the company's equity to 14.7 million kroons.
Foreign institutional investors bought 40 percent of the issue and local institutional and small investors the rest, Rahumaa said.
The subscription to foreign investors was organised with Swedish Enskilda, he added.
Fakto has also submitted an application to list its shares on the Tallinn bourse.
Fakto had a net profit of 1.56 million kroons and a turnover of 146 million kroons in 1996.
